decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

Site location plan; (PL) 010; 100 Rev B; 101; 102; 103; 104; 120 Rev A; 121 Rev A; 130; 131; 132; 133; 140; 141 Rev A; 142; 150; 151; 160; 161; 161; 162; 163; 200 Rev C; 201 Rev E; 202 Rev E; 203 Rev C; 204 Rev C; 220 Rev E; 221 Rev E; 230 Rev C; 231 Rev C; 232 Rev E; 233 Rev C; 401; 410; 411; 412; 531; 541; 542 Rev B; 800; 801; 802; Arboriculture Impact Assessment and Method Statement" dated 23/03/2026 by Allarboriculture ref. AAAIAFITZ;  Basement Impact Assessment and Ground Investigation Report by Ground Water and Constant Structural Design Ltd. (December 2025); Campbell Reith BIA Audit report (ref: 14291-39) dated January 2026) Noise Impact Assessment (dated 13/05/2025) by Clement Acoustics Ref: 19250; Design and Access Statement by Architecture for London (dated May 2025);  Planning Statement by Maddox Planning (dated June 2025); Heritage Statement by And Heritage Ltd. (dated June 2025) and Archaeological Impact Assessment by A H Heritage Planning (dated 02/05/2025) ref: AH2243.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - A plan showing the proposed pipe service run linking the ASHP to the house shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority before relevant part of the work is begun.

Reason: To ensure that the development will not have an adverse effect on existing trees and in order to maintain the character and amenity of the area inaccordance with the requirements of policies A2 and A3 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 5 - The critical elements of both permanent and temporary basement construction works shall be inspected, approved and monitored throughout their duration by the appointed Chartered Structural Engineer Tom Ashton to ensure compliance with the design which has been checked and approved by a building control body. Any subsequent change or reappointment shall be confirmed in writing with the Local Planning Authority before the continuation with the relevant part of the construction works.
 
Reason: To ensure proper consideration of the structural stability of neighbouring buildings and to safeguard the appearance and character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1, D2 and A5 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 6 - The development shall not be carried out other than in strict accordance with the methodologies, recommendations and requirements of the Basement Impact Assessment (Basement Impact Assessment by Constant, Ref. 24064/R1/BC/RevP3, dated 29/04/2025;  and audit dated 19/01/2026) hereby approved, and the confirmation at the detailed design stage that the damage impact assessment would be limited to Burland Category 1 (very slight). 
�


Reason: To ensure proper consideration of the structural stability of neighbouring buildings and to safeguard the appearance and character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1, D2 and A5 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.

Condition : 7 - The external noise level emitted from plant, machinery or equipment at the development with specified noise mitigation hereby approved shall be lower than the typical existing background noise level by at least 10dBA, by 15dBA where the source is tonal, as assessed according to BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most affected noise sensitive premises, with machinery operating at maximum capacity and thereafter be permanently retained.
 
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise from mechanical installations/ equipment in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017
Condition : 8 - Prior to use, machinery, plant or equipment at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such. 
 
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site and surrounding premises is not adversely affected by vibration in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017  
Condition : 9 - Prior to the commencement of works on site, tree protection measures shall be installed and working practices adopted in accordance with the document entitled "Arboriculture Impact Assessment and Method Statement" dated 23/03/2026 by Allarboriculture ref. AAAIAFITZ.  All trees on the site, or parts of trees grow from adjoining sites, unless shown on the permitted drawings as being removed, shall be retained and protected from damage in accordance with BS5837:2012 and with the approved protection details. The development shall be monitored by the project arboriculturalist in accordance with the approved report.
 
Reason: To ensure that the development will not have an adverse effect on existing trees and in order to maintain the character and amenity of the area in accordance with the requirements of policies A2 and A3 of the Camden Local Plan.
Condition : 10 - Prior to occupation, full details of flood protection measures including basement water proofing via a tanking system, sump pump, and non-return valve shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Systems shall thereafter be permanently retained and maintained in accordance with the approved details. 

Reason: To protect the occupants in the event of a flood in accordance with policy CC3 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017
Condition : 11 - Prior to first use of the air source heat pump hereby approved, the active cooling function shall be disabled on the factory setting and the air source heat pump shall be used for the purposes of heating only.

Reason: To ensure the proposal is energy efficient and sustainable in accordance with policy CC2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
description: Amalgamation of two flats to create a family home, the replacement of a two-storey lean-to extension and removal of the existing external staircase, enlargement of the existing roof dormer, reinstatement of entrance portico, fitting of new light tunnels and high-level windows to basement, the installation of an Air Source Heat Pump, and other associated external alterations and remedial works. Internal alterations proposed include lowering of the basement floor level, internal layout changes and associated alterations and remedial works.
